title.narrative: Output 1.2. Increased institutional capacity of workers’ organizations

description.narrative: • A work plan to enhance trade union cooperation in Iraq through supporting the established Trade Union Coordination Committee (TUCC) has been developed and agreed with the Federation of Iraq Trade Unions (FITU), the General Federation of Iraq Workers (GFIW), and the Congress of Iraqi Workers Federations and Unions (CIWFU) with emphasis on activities related to organizing new groups of workers through improved services and new communication strategies. • GFITU, GFIW, and the Kurdistan Trade Union Federation were supported to organize workers in the informal economy mainly in construction and agriculture through the active engagement in the ILO PROSPECT and EIIP projects activities in Dohuk, Nineveh, and Mosul governorates. • GFITU, GFIW, and CIWFU, were supported to develop a joint trade union position and recommendations in preparation for their meeting with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) delegation to Iraq to conduct consultations with different stakeholders on the pension systems reform according to IMF Article. IV ( December 2022). • The Iraqi workers’ organizations with the support of the ILO foresee to achieve the following results by the end of the biennium: - A scoping study on the recent state of the TU movement in Iraq (membership, structures, bylaws, action plans...etc) with recommendations. - A national Trade Union (TU) workshop to validate the recommendations of the study and develop a joint strategy to develop the TU structures and roles through organizing. • During 2022, ILO held different technical meetings for the TUCC to facilitate the cooperation among its affiliates (FITU, GFIW, CIWFU, and Kurdistan Trade Union Federation) through improve their engagement with the different ILO interventions in Iraq to organizing new groups of workers through improved services and new communication strategies. Under this output, the ILO will continue to support the TU committee established to coordinate among the different national centers to develop a joint strategy to develop the trade unions roles and structures through providing technical support to organize new groups of workers through improved services and innovative approaches. • On December 12, 2022, ILO held a preparatory meeting with Iraqi workers’ representatives for the IMF Art. IV consultations on the pension systems reform in Iraq. The meeting assisted the representatives of the Federation of Iraqi Trade Unions (FITU), General Federation of Iraq Workers (GFIW) and Conference of Iraqi Workers Federations and Unions (CIWFU) to develop a joint trade union statement about workers vision and concerns in order to speak with one voice during their meeting with IMF delegation. • ILO will technically and financially support the different national trade union centers through TUCC to develop an evidence based strategy aiming at enhancing the trade unions roles and structures, organize new groups of workers through improved services and innovative approaches, and promote collective bargaining and social dialogue.
